notes.title: Update Note - v1.1.250110 (QoL)
notes.notes:
[b]Interface:[/b]

[list]
[*] Quick access to verbs using 'Z', 'X', and 'C' keys.
[*] Indicator for previously used dialogue options.
[*] Previously used dialogue is highlighted again when new options are available.
[*] Lantern added to highlight important objects for the current chapter (easy mode).
[*] Adventurer's Guide added (quick guide for in-game controls).
[*] New confirmation prompts for menu actions.
[*] Improved functionality of Enter and Escape keys for menu navigation.
[*] Object highlight auras now turn off when starting an action (with some exceptions).
[*] Emergency fix added for situations where actions were blocked (requires opening the inventory).
[/list]

[b]Settings:[/b]

[list]
[*] Adjustable movement speed for the main character.
[*] Quick configuration screen added at the start of a new game.
[*] Added resolution options for windowed mode.
[*] Adjustable borders for windowed mode.
[*] Auto-save enabled during key moments of the game.
[/list]

[b]Adjustments:[/b]

[list]
[*] Improved timing for reading or listening to dialogue lines.
[*] Fixed missing dialogue bubbles when loading saved games.
[*] Fixed configuration updates not applying to saved games.
[*] The main character will no longer change position when returning from the menu.
[*] The right path in the plaza is now blocked until obtaining the "first mission" (reducing difficulty).
[*] Improved transitions to prevent mouse interaction during animations.
[*] Additional enhancements to transition moments.
[*] Volume adjustments for certain scenes.
[*] Restored laboratory element states after a temporal rollback.
[*] Fixed translation errors in the English credits.
[/list]

notes.title: Update notes - v1.0.240729
notes.notes:
You can now use the 'space bar' to move the character to the cursor or interact with the UI ingame (same reaction as simple left click).
Fixed some glitches in the settings menu.

notes.title: We're going on an adventure!
notes.notes:
We are finally there! We are happy to announce that "Ramas' Call: Twisted timing" is launching today!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44440924/1b3d0e27adfeec291de2b6d07dfb7cda6ce93ac0.png[/img]
Throughout the journey, many people will cross your path—sometimes by chance, sometimes by luck, and sometimes, destiny is testing your skills. Recognize each moment so you can wisely choose your best self!
Be brave and overcome challenges following your gut. Search for clues and secrets like a meticulous detective. Use your dreamer side, and make the world bigger with your imagination. Unleash your silver tongue to charm everyone around you. Or just combine all these roles to fully experience the adventure.

Be one of the first to try our adventure and uncover it's hidden challenges!
Have fun! To the adventure!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44440924/6fb3769b347e1404b6fd65457b1324746e6666c1.png[/img]

notes.title: The time has come! Gear up and pack your bags!
notes.notes:
[b]Greetings adventurers!!![/b]

We're thrilled to announce that we finally have a release date set for the game. After a long journey of development, we're ready to share our creation with all of you starting [b]May 20th[/b], right here on Steam!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44440924/fab45b71d54fc0d3f692c5e872cf234a3db89e64.png[/img]

Circle the date on your calendars and set those alarms to dive into an exciting adventure filled with mysteries, challenges, and unforgettable moments. Get ready to explore exotic locations and meet intriguing characters in an experience that's sure to captivate your hearts and minds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44440924/bec72ae04151b6649865b1c72a487dfe80274d86.gif[/img]

We want to sincerely thank everyone who has been a part of this journey so far. Your feedback, support, and enthusiasm have driven us to reach this exciting milestone. We can't wait to see all of you playing and experiencing what we've created for you!

The countdown has begun, the adventure is just a few clicks away!

notes.title: Next Fest with Ramas' Call: Twisted timing
notes.notes:
Hi there, fellow adventurers!

Steam Next Fest is just around the corner. You'll be able to play the demos of upcoming titles, and we're thrilled to announce that we'll be part of the 2024 edition! It will take place from February 5th to 12th. Enjoy the festival and share your favorite games with your friends. We hope that Ramas' Call is one of them!

Sometimes, unplanned journeys turn out to be the best. Get ready for a new epic odyssey!

An experimental error transports Mic to a world full of magic and mystery. Put yourself in the shoes of a tabletop role-playing game enthusiast who gets challenged to become a bold adventurer! Negotiate alliances as a silver-tongued noble, search for clues and secrets like a cunning detective. Blend all these roles together and experience the unique journey that awaits you.

The fun is just a click away!

We invite you to try the demo. After playing, tell us what you think through our [url=https://linktr.ee/oneofusstudios] Linktree - Social Networks[/url] or join our [url=https://discord.gg/Bsm6yxnbWR]Discord Channel[/url].
